proof.text: Choose the ordinary quotient model M and its whole-system coherent derived comparison D with the supplied calculus. Construct the ordinary balanced scalar tower comparison, keeping its quotient-generator formula.

The quotient system of a good complex is K-flat: evaluate its tensor with an acyclic system, use finite quotient K-flatness and componentwise exactness. Thus the universal scalar cochain counit is invertible on it. Compose with the supplied normalized Roos comparison and the ordinary scalar tower comparison, and descend this natural isomorphism through the good-complex localization.

For any coherent presentation, compare it to the canonical strict quotient complex using its strict isomorphism a. Transport the ordinary scalar tower isomorphism through a inverse. Its generator formula is the required one. Naturality of the scalar counit and Roos bridge moves Q(a) across the comparison; cancel a with its inverse and use the descended comparison equation. Package this normalized realization. The separate unnormalized realization theorem is its realization field.
